inner_arch.premise: Before ever seeing Pyrrha, from its name alone the traveler knew an enclosed fortified city on the slopes of a bay, with high windows and towers like a goblet, a deep square in the center, and a well in the middle.
inner_arch.rupture: The instant the traveler sets foot in actual Pyrrha, the sea is hidden out of sight behind a coastal dune; straight streets run between low house groups separated by stacks of lumber and noisy sawmills while coastal wind turns the metal vanes of water pumps.
inner_arch.irreversible_nominal_rebinding: Crossing the arrival threshold irrevocably rebinds the token 'PYRRHA' to this dusty view, ochre glare, sawmill buzzing, and rattling wind-pumps. Uttering 'PYRRHA' can never again summon the gulf city—and shatters even silent pre-arrival quarantine—leaving the fortified bay city forever without a name.

anti_trude_vector.medium: Biphasic Nominal-Rupture Architectural & Acoustic Apparatus (Canvas + WebAudio + Quarantine Ocular)

guild.name: pyrrha-critic
guild.responsibility: Blindfolded literary & technical verifier auditing blind recognition, HG-1..HG-4 hard gates, J_dom < 0.35, causal nominal rupture invariants, and Royal Plates (map.png, map.svg, image.png).

hard_gates.HG-1: Standalone clean runtime: zero http(s)://, ../, fetch(, or ES module syntax; node --check clean on layers/*.js and inline script; zero pageerror/console.error in Chromium at 1280x800 and 390x844.
hard_gates.HG-2: Anti-Trude DOM morphology: all 5 chartered custom elements present in <body>, zero generic layout/text tags in <body>, 100% .pyr-* CSS classes, J_dom < 0.35.
hard_gates.HG-3: Calvino stone causality: pre-arrival binds 'PYRRHA' to goblet_bay_city (seaVisible=true, gobletCityName='PYRRHA'); crossThreshold() irrevocably rebinds 'PYRRHA' to dune_sawmill_grid (seaVisible=false, gobletCityName=null, namelessExile=true); setQuarantine(true) inspects nameless gulf phantom while keeping gobletCityName=null, and summonByName('PYRRHA') shatters quarantine back to sawmills & pumps; reset() restores pre-arrival state.
hard_gates.HG-4: Viewports, accessibility & Royal Plates: zero overflow at 1280x800 and 390x844, prefers-reduced-motion honored, keyboard controls operational, and map.png (1600x1200) + image.png (1600x1000) verified on disk and loaded cleanly inside <pyrrha-plate-drawer>.
